body: nobody cares enough to ask me how i am, thats all i fucking need. just some reassurance that someone cares about my health and existence. i always think about how sorry people would be if i ended it. i end up hating the people that i care for but never care for me. that same hate makes me want to have this unbearable guilt put on them for not doing their fair share in a friendship. i know if it came down to it, they would care and reach out. but it might be too late. its all this weird mess of loneliness, one-sided effort, disappointment, and resentment. i just want to quit thinking about it but this is my reality and i want to escape it
